cated to providing the timely, safe,
and courteous service our clients de-
serve.
OTS provides ADA Paratransit service
through Green River Intra-County Trans-
it Systems (GRITS). Paratransit services
are available via a shared ride, curb-to-
curb program for clients certified
through OTS. This service is reservation-
based and is available anywhere in the
City of Owensboro that is within 3/4 of a
mile from a OTS bus stop. Services can
be utilized for medical appointments,
pharmacy, shopping, or any other errand
or appointment. An application must be
submitted and approved by OTS to be
eligible for paratransit services. Applica-
tions can be found on the OTS website,
mailed out, or picked up at the OTS of-
fice.

• Paratransit is a specialized service for
people with disabilities who are not able
to ride fixed-route public transportation
buses.
• There is no charge to apply for para-
transit services. Once a completed ap-
plication is turned into OTS it takes up
to 21 days for a decision to be made.
You will be notified via a letter in the
mail of OTS’ decision.
• Once you are approved, you can begin
scheduling rides through GRITS by
calling 270-686-1651 during the hours
of 8:00am to 4:30pm Monday through
Sunday. You must give at least 24-hour
notice for a trip
• Trips cost $2.00 each way and you can
go anywhere in the City of Owensboro
as long as it is within 3/4 of a mile of an
OTS bus stop.
• All approved paratransit riders are al-
lowed the be accompanied by one per-
sonal care attendant (PCA) and one
escort
• All scheduling and canceling of trips is
through calling GRITS and speaking to
their representatives.

If Denied for Paratransit:
• If your application for Paratransit is denied,
you have up to 60 days to submit an appeal.
• Your appeal will be reviewed by the Mayor’s
Committee for Person’s with Disabilities.
• You will receive written notification of the
date and time of your hearing.
ACCS/GRITS provides equipment that exceeds
ADA requirements. These vehicles have larger lift
platforms with greater weigh capacities. Ramp-
equipped vehicles are also available in lieu of lift
equipped buses.
